scene: Inside the rumbling cab, the tow truck driver hums through neon drizzle.
beats: Static crackles into smooth synth jazz as the tow truck halts under buzzing discharge tubes. The passenger door glides open onto Neon Sign Hospital.
A chilled coil of argon tubing glows inside with a gentle hum. The driver honks twice, braking beside glowing torches as the door clicks open.
The driver taps the flamingo, sparking a flash of hot pink brilliance. You roll through the wide hangar doors, which swing open with a hiss.
picture: Side view inside the wide truck cab. On the left, the silver CB radio sits on the dash beside the robotic driver. In the centre, the player sits on a bench seat beside a glowing blue foam cooler. Up high, an unlit miniature neon flamingo hangs from the mirror.
shown: a bulky silver CB radio with dangling microphone on the left dashboard
a blue foam cooler glowing with faint purple light sitting in centre
a miniature neon flamingo hanging unlit from the rear-view mirror up high

after.label: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital
Stay on
after.beat: You wave the hospital goodbye as the tow truck rattles on. At the depot, you board a clanking bridge crawler that carries you up to Gear Bridge's turning cogs.
